boar: A bristly forest pig with a temper. Good eating, and good leather.
deer: Quick and wary. It bolts at the first sound of you.
wolf: Grey hunters of the forests and the snows. Feed one a bone and it may follow you for life.
ghoul: What the dead become when the dark keeps them. Slow, hungry, and never alone for long.
charred_ghoul: A ghoul that walked through fire and kept walking.
skeleton: Bones held together by spite and a good bow. The sun undoes them.
spider: Eight legs, eight eyes, and patience. It climbs where you can't.
cave_spider: Small, quick and venomous. Where there's one, there's a nest.
fuseling: It creeps up quietly and hisses once. Then it doesn't hiss again.
slime: A jelly that splits when struck. Bounces after you in the swamps and the deep places.
witch: She brews in her hut and throws what she brews. Mind her bottles.
husk: A ghoul dried by the desert sun. The sun doesn't burn it any more.
drowned: The sea gave this one back. Some still carry what they drowned with.
stray: A skeleton from the frozen wastes. Its arrows leave you slow and cold.
wraith: A cold shape that drifts through the night, more a chill than a thing.
cinder_golem: A giant of slag and ember that keeps the way below. Its core burns hotter than any forge.
cinder_wisp: A spinning knot of cinders that throws fire from afar.
magma_slime: Molten jelly from the Depths. It splits like its swamp cousin, but it burns.
werewolf: A man by day. By the full moon, something else.
ogre: Big, slow and very strong. It carries a club the size of a tree.
crocodile: It lies still in the shallows like a log. Logs don't bite.
shark: A hunter of the deep blue. It smells blood a long way off.
scorpion: A desert creature with a sting in its tail.
iron_golem: A villager's guardian of iron and patience. Hurt the village and it remembers.
grave_warden: It keeps the old graves, and does not like to be disturbed.
broodmother: The mother of spiders. The little ones never stop coming while she lives.
hex_matron: A witch who stopped brewing for others long ago.
mimic: It looks just like a chest. It is not a chest.
rift_ghoul: A ghoul touched by the tear. Its eyes are wrong.
herobrine: White eyes in the dark. Whoever he is, the tear is his doing.
hollow_archmage: A mage who studied too long in his tower and forgot how to stop.
minotaur: Horned and huge, it keeps its maze and charges whatever comes in.
enderman: Tall and quiet. It doesn't like to be looked in the eye.
ender_dragon: The dragon of the End, circling its pillars of crystal.
warden: Blind, and it doesn't need to see. It hears your heart.
ghast: A great weeping cloud that spits fire. Its tears are worth more than you'd think.
zombie_pigman: A pigman of the Depths. Leave the one alone and the rest leave you alone.
wither_skeleton: A tall black skeleton of the Depths' fortresses. Its blade withers.
wither: Three heads and no mercy. It was never meant to be woken.
wither_storm: The Wither grown monstrous, swallowing the land around it.
shulker: A box that watches. Its shots lift you off the ground.
aerwhale: A whale that swims the open sky above the clouds.
moa: A great flightless bird of the Skylands. Raised from an egg, it can be ridden.
valkyrie_queen: Queen of the sky temple. She won't fight until you've earned it.
lich_king: A king who would not stay dead, still ruling his halls of bone.
giant: So tall its head is in the trees. Each step shakes the ground.
moose: A huge deer of the cold forests. Gentle, until it isn't.
bison: A shaggy beast of the plains, as strong as it looks.
elephant: A grey giant of the warm lands, wise and slow to anger.
orca: Black and white and clever. It hunts the seas in families.
bald_eagle: A great bird of prey with a white head and sharp eyes.
crow: A clever black bird. It notices everything, and remembers faces.
seagull: It wants your food. It will have your food.
dragonfly: A bright darting thing over still water.
firefly: A little light that drifts over the grass on warm nights.
naga: A great serpent with a hood, guardian of old places.
night_lord: A lord of the dark hours. The night is its court.
dead_king: A crown on a skull, and an army that still answers it.
verdant_dragon: The forest's dragon, green as the deep woods.
frost_dragon: The dragon of the frozen peaks. Its breath turns rain to hail.
sand_dragon: The desert's dragon, which swims through dunes as through water.
tide_dragon: The sea's dragon, which rises from the deep.
ember_dragon: The dragon of the Depths, wreathed in fire.
storm_dragon: The dragon of the Skylands, riding the thunder.
bog_dragon: The swamp's dragon, slow and patient and poisonous.
pirate: A sea raider with a cutlass and no manners.
pirate_captain: The pirates' captain. Where there's a captain, there's a ship, and treasure.
raider: A villager who chose the axe over the plough.
warlock: A spellcaster who deals in curses.
bee: A busy little thing. Leave its hive alone and it leaves you alone.
fox: A sly red hunter. It steals what you drop.
panda: It eats bamboo, mostly. And naps.
polar_bear: The white bear of the north. Fierce if you come near its cubs.
brown_bear: A big forest bear. It likes honey and berries, and being left alone.
tiger: A striped hunter of the jungle, silent until it pounces.
snow_leopard: A pale ghost of the high peaks, seldom seen.
lion: The king of the savanna, with a mane to prove it.
horse: Tame one and the land gets a good deal smaller.
rabbit: Quick, twitchy and fond of carrots. Its foot is said to bring luck.
cow: Milk, leather and beef, all from one patient animal.
pig: Happy in mud, happier with a carrot. Saddle one if you dare.
sheep: Shear it for wool; it grows back. Dye it and it grows back that colour.
chicken: Eggs, feathers and a good supper. Very poor at flying.
donkey: A sturdy beast that carries a chest on its back.
llama: It carries your things and spits at whatever annoys it.
camel: Tall enough for two riders, and it laughs at the desert sun.
snow_fox: A white fox of the snowfields, hard to see until it moves.
raccoon: A masked thief of bins and chests. Clever little hands.
cat: It chooses you, not the other way round.
ocelot: A shy jungle cat. Patience and fish may win its trust.
goat: It climbs where nothing else will, and rams whatever's in its way.
armadillo: Curls into a ball of armour when frightened. Its scutes make fine plating.
mouse: Small, quick and always near the grain.
turkey: A big, proud bird that gobbles at everything.
duck: Paddles about ponds and quacks at passers-by.
parrot: Bright and chatty. It mimics the sounds of whatever is near.
bat: It hangs in caves and flutters about at dusk.
squid: Ink, and a great many arms.
glow_squid: A squid that glows softly in the deep dark waters.
cod: A common sea fish, and good eating.
salmon: It swims upstream in cold rivers.
tropical_fish: Colourful little fish of the warm reefs.
pufferfish: Swells up with spines when threatened. Don't eat it raw.
dolphin: A playful swimmer that leads sailors to treasure.
turtle: Slow on land, graceful in the sea. It always returns to the beach it hatched on.
axolotl: A smiling little salamander of underground pools. It fights beside you in water.
frog: It croaks in the swamp and eats what buzzes near.
aerbunny: A fluffy rabbit of the sky. Hold one and you float gently down.
stone_mite: A tiny thing living in stone. Break the wrong block and out they pour.
rattlesnake: It rattles before it strikes. Listen.
green_snake: A jungle snake, quick and green.
adder: A small venomous snake of the grass.
lioness: She does the hunting for the pride.
panther: A black cat of the jungle shadows.
phyg: A winged pig of the Skylands. Saddle it and it flies.
flying_cow: A cow with wings. The Skylands are like that.
sheepuff: A sheep of the clouds, puffed up and floating.
cockatrice: Half bird, half serpent, and its gaze stings.
rot_king: The rotting king of the dead in the barrows.
rift_skeleton: A skeleton the tear touched. Its bones glow wrong.
rift_spider: A spider from the tear, its legs too many and too long.
verdant_drake: A young forest dragon, raised from an egg. It can carry you.
sand_drake: A young sand dragon. Ride it over the dunes.
frost_drake: A young frost dragon, cold to the touch.
bog_drake: A young swamp dragon, slow and steady.
ember_drake: A young fire dragon of the Depths.
storm_drake: A young storm dragon that rides the wind.
tide_drake: A young sea dragon, as at home in water as in air.
spirit_wolf: A wolf of mist and moonlight, called by a spell.
zephyr: A cloud that blows snowballs at you. The Skylands' prankster.
swet: A jelly of the Skylands that gloms onto you.
golden_swet: A golden jelly of the Skylands, sweeter and stickier.
aechor_plant: A plant that spits poison at whatever walks by.
end_crystal: A crystal on a pillar that heals the dragon of the End. Break them first.
ender_drake: A young dragon of the End, hatched from its egg.
ember_lord: Lord of the burning halls of the Depths.
gaoler: The keeper of the dungeon cells. It carries the keys.
warden_sun: One of the twin wardens, burning bright as noon.
warden_moon: One of the twin wardens, cold and silver as night.
frost_fuseling: A fuseling of the snows. Its blast freezes.
bog_fuseling: A fuseling of the swamp. Its blast poisons.
sandstone_golem: A golem of carved sandstone guarding the desert's ruins.
moss_golem: A golem overgrown with moss, slow and old.
ember_fuseling: A fuseling of the Depths. Its blast burns.
moss_fuseling: A fuseling grown over with moss.
sky_fuseling: A fuseling that drifts on the Skylands' winds.
sulfur_slime: A yellow slime of the Depths that stinks of sulphur.
crystal_wisp: A drifting wisp of crystal light.
scorched_skeleton: A skeleton burnt black, with fire in its arrows.
redlands_fuseling: A fuseling of the red badlands.
jungle_fuseling: A fuseling hiding in the jungle green.
beach_fuseling: A fuseling lurking on the sand.
savanna_fuseling: A fuseling of the dry grasslands.
mushroom_fuseling: A fuseling of the mushroom fields.
savanna_golem: A golem of red clay and grass.
gravel_fuseling: A fuseling that looks like a heap of gravel.
whirlwind: A spinning column of wind that lifts you off your feet.
valkyrie: A winged warrior of the sky temple.
end_slime: A slime from the End, pale and strange.
end_fish: A fish that swims through the End's air.
cubozoa: A box jellyfish of the End. Its sting lingers.
silk_moth: A moth of the End whose silk is prized.
shadow_walker: A shape that walks in the dark between things.
slider: A stone block that slides at you in the dungeons of the sky.
sentry: A dungeon guard of stone that wakes when you come near.
sun_spirit: The spirit of the sun, enthroned in the sky palace.
fire_minion: A small servant of the sun spirit, made of flame.
evil_whirlwind: A dark whirlwind that hurls you about.
gazelle: A swift deer of the savanna that bounds away.
kangaroo: It boxes. It carries its young in a pouch.
toucan: A bright-beaked bird of the jungle canopy.
hummingbird: A tiny bird that hovers at flowers.
roadrunner: It runs fast across the badlands. Very fast.
lobster: A clawed creature of the shallows.
hydrogen_jellyfish: A floating jellyfish full of gas. Don't pop it near anything you love.
flying_pig: A pig that flies. Someone said it never would.
jungle_skeleton: A skeleton overgrown with vines in the jungle's ruins.
graveyard_lich: A lich who rules the graveyard at night.
alligator_snapping_turtle: Its jaws snap shut on anything that comes close.
anteater: A long snout and a longer tongue, for ants.
banana_slug: A big yellow slug that leaves a sticky trail.
blobfish: A deep-sea fish that looks sad out of water.
blue_jay: A noisy blue bird of the woods.
bone_serpent: A great serpent of bone that swims through lava.
bunfungus: A rabbit-shaped mushroom creature. Gentle, until it isn't.
cachalot_whale: The great sperm whale, hunter of the deep.
caiman: A small crocodile of the swamps.
capuchin_monkey: A clever little monkey that throws things.
catfish: A whiskered fish that swallows things whole.
centipede_head: A centipede of the caves, all legs and venom.
comb_jelly: A jelly that shimmers with rainbow light.
cosmaw: A jaw floating in the End.
cosmic_cod: A fish that schools through the End's void.
crimson_mosquito: A blood-drinking insect of the crimson forests.
devils_hole_pupfish: A tiny fish of one tiny pool.
dropbear: It drops from the trees onto your head.
emu: A tall flightless bird, fast and fierce.
endergrade: A little tardigrade of the End.
enderiophage: A virus-like thing of the End that infects what it touches.
farseer: An eye from beyond. It sees you.
flutter: A flower-moth that flutters about the caves.
flying_fish: It leaps out of the sea and glides.
frilled_shark: An ancient shark of the deep, full of needle teeth.
froststalker: A cold hunter of the snows, with icy spines.
gelada_monkey: A grass-eating monkey of the highlands.
giant_squid: A squid as long as a ship, in the deepest waters.
gorilla: Strong and gentle, and very strong.
guster: A sand whirlwind of the desert.
hammerhead_shark: A shark with a head like a hammer.
jerboa: A tiny hopping desert mouse with long legs.
komodo_dragon: A huge lizard with a venomous bite.
laviathan: A great beast that swims through lava.
leafcutter_ant: Ants that carry leaves home to their colony.
maned_wolf: A tall, long-legged wolf of the grasslands.
mantis_shrimp: A colourful shrimp with a punch that breaks shells.
mimic_octopus: An octopus that becomes whatever it likes.
mimicube: A cube that copies whatever you hold.
mudskipper: A fish that walks on land.
mungus: A creature with a mushroom on its back.
murmur: A whispering thing of the deep caves.
platypus: Duck bill, beaver tail, venomous spur. Make of it what you will.
potoo: A bird that pretends to be a branch.
rhinoceros: A great horned beast that charges.
rocky_roller: A creature that rolls through the caves like a boulder.
sea_bear: A bear that lives in the sea. Mind the circle.
seal: A sleek swimmer that barks on the shore.
shoebill: A huge-billed bird that stands very, very still.
skelewag: A skeleton fish of the drowned ruins.
soul_vulture: A vulture of the soul valleys that circles the dying.
spectre: A ghostly ray that glides through the End.
straddler: A stilt-legged creature that walks on lava.
sugar_glider: A tiny animal that glides from tree to tree.
sunbird: A great bird that soars high over the land. Its feathers shine like the sun.
tarantula_hawk: A huge wasp that hunts spiders.
terrapin: A little turtle of ponds and rivers.
triops: A tiny ancient shrimp of rain pools.
tusklin: A tusked beast of the cold mountains.
underminer: A ghostly miner who still digs in the deep.
void_worm: A colossal worm that swims through the void beneath the End.
warped_mosco: A giant mosquito of the warped forests.
warped_toad: A toad of the warped forests with a long tongue.
